grammar.summary: 本课学习表「与生俱来」的 be born + 补语与 the one...who 强调。

points.title: the...who 的排他性定义
points.explanation: He was the one actor who truly represented the West. 定语从句限定独特身份：the one...who = 唯有他。

examples.en: He created the basic formula of the western film.
examples.cn: 他创造了西部片的基本范式。

points.title: 表「碰巧」的 happen to do
points.explanation: the West happened to be his home. happen to = 碰巧，客观陈述巧合的利器。

examples.en: The West happened to be his home territory.
